description.value: EZYMart is a family-run convenience store in Vancouver with a multicultural product focus, stocking fresh produce, organic goods, snacks, drinks, and home and personal care items. Customer reviews praise its organized layout and friendly ownership. The brand appears to operate multiple Vancouver locations under a shared website.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places this store at 1099 Southwest Marine Drive, but the website consistently shows a different address (1092 West Broadway, Vancouver BC), indicating either multiple locations or a mismatch between this OSM node and the website. The website confirms basic grocery and convenience product lines (snacks, drinks, fresh produce, home and personal care), but contains Lorem ipsum placeholder text in product category descriptions and a New York City area code (212) phone number, both of which are red flags for a template or incompletely set-up website. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists 1099 Southwest Marine Drive but website consistently shows 1092 West Broadway, Vancouver BC — may be a different location or the website serves a chain and this node is a separate unlisted branch.
Phone number +1 (212)-695-1962 uses a New York City area code, which is atypical for a Vancouver business and may indicate a template or placeholder contact.
Product category pages contain Lorem ipsum placeholder text, suggesting the website is partially built from a template and may not accurately reflect current in-store inventory.
No /locations/ page content was captured to confirm whether 1099 SW Marine Drive is a listed branch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The website address (1092 West Broadway) does not match the OSM address (1099 Southwest Marine Drive), making it unclear whether this website belongs to this specific location. Additionally, the website contains Lorem ipsum placeholder text and a New York City area code phone number, raising questions about whether the web presence is complete or correctly associated with this OSM node.

wow_evidence: family-run convenience store in Vancouver with a multicultural product focus
